title: DCERPCNetlogon: convert to ws_log system
description:
Use the ws_log system instead of custom debug routines. If Wireshark
isn't compiled for the Debug target, the compiler will optimize away all
these calls.

Convert custom `debugprintf()` calls to `ws_debug()` calls. Remove
trailing newline from all such calls since the log framework handles
those.

Rewrite debugging function `printnbyte()`:

* Do nothing if debug logging is disabled.
* Log its hexdumps (at the DEBUG level) instead of writing them to
  stderr.
* Accept a scratch `wmem_allocator_t *` for allocating a buffer to hold
  the hexdump.
* Remove the `txt2` parameter since it was only used to add a trailing
  newline to the hexdump.

Minor formatting touch-ups on calls to `printnbyte()`.

Ping #19519

notes.body: `packet-ntlmssp.c` uses the same `printnbyte()` function as this dissector. No others use a function by this name, but the "feature" may be duplicated elsewhere with a different name.
